name: Electron Cash
description: Electrum pattern: version blob signed by a pinned coin address; notify-only.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Electron Cash's Qt updater retrieves a JSON version announcement, accepts newer matching variants only when the message verifies under one of three hard-coded Bitcoin Cash addresses, and presents the project download page. The checked-in flow performs notification and manual download rather than automatic installation.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; the claim is limited to the inspected Qt checker and does not generalize to other platform front ends.

original_evidence.text: | Electron Cash | github.com/Electron-Cash/Electron-Cash | Python/PyQt5 desktop (not actually Electron) | Y | notify (opt-in auto-check via `has_auto_update_check`/`set_auto_update_check`; also manual "Check for Updates" menu item); never auto-downloads/installs | N (only opens browser to static download page `electroncash.org/#download`) | https (raw.github.com, OS trust store, no cert pinning) | Y (each version string in the JSON dict is individually signed, not the file as a whole) | signature (Bitcoin/BCH message-signing, secp256k1 ECDSA) — verifies only the version-string announcement, not any binary payload | pinned-in-binary (`VERSION_ANNOUNCEMENT_SIGNING_ADDRESSES` hardcoded BCH addresses) | electroncash_gui/qt/update_checker.py:66-73 (URL + pinned addresses), :117-166 (`_process_server_reply` sig check via `bitcoin.verify_message`); electroncash_gui/qt/main_window.py:5179-5182 (auto-check toggle) |
